Method: PLT stub `adrp x16, 0x44000` plus `ldr x17,

Limitations: `.rela.dyn` (ANDROID-packed) was not decoded; `.relr.dyn` was not decoded. Relocations were read from llvm-objdump, which decoded `.rela.plt` correctly.

_debugdata` was extracted (10736 bytes) and decompressed with xz to 53536 bytes. It contains a local symbol table (`llvm-nm`: 674 entries). Names below come from this table. These are local/debug names and are not dynamic exports.
Function bounds come from the next symbol start, not from prologue heuristics. The heuristic prologue scan was discarded.
_create` (0x20378–0x204b8, size 320) contains `bl 0x3c920` at 0x203cc to the TrackPlayerBase C1Ev PLT stub.
_realize` (0x207b4–0x21608, size 3668) contains `bl 0x3c940` at 0x21348 (TrackPlayerBase::init) and `bl 0x3cac0` at 0x21170 (AudioTrack C1).
_CreateAudioPlayer` does not contain a direct `bl` to any of the six target PLT stubs.
So the direct edges are IEngine
_realize` is reached from this path only if a direct bl from `android
_CreateAudioPlayer` to 0x207b4 exists. That was not found: no bl to 0x207b4 was observed in either function body. Its caller is therefore UNKNOWN.
Function-pointer check: a search for 0x207b4 and 0x20378 as 8-byte values in libwilhelm.so found none. The value 0x34e58 (IEngine
_CreateAudioPlayer) appears once, at file offset 0x43278. No relocation covers 0x43278, and the debug table has no data symbol there. Its role is UNKNOWN.
Bounded at the next symbol (0x75ce8). The bounded range contains 34 bl/blr/br instructions.
Indirect call: one `blr x9` at 0x76248 lies outside the bounded range (0x75ce8 onward was not checked), so it is not attributed to init.
No `AudioTrack::AudioTrack` constructor call appears in the bounded range.

Conclusion: `TrackPlayerBase::init` initializes state and attaches to an AudioTrack that it receives (the `sp<AudioTrack>` argument). It does not create an AudioTrack. The call edge `TrackPlayerBase::init` → `AudioTrack` C1 is not present in the bounded range.
